info.name: VectorSpace API v1
info.description:
A second client of the same /api/v1 the web app uses, unchanged. Generated by apps/api/postman/build_collection.py; edit that, not this file.

Run order matters: Me saves the ids later folders use. Data is the synthetic Demo School from app/seed.py locally and in CI, or the synthetic pilot school when deployed.

Requests marked by allow_writes leave rows behind and are skipped unless the environment sets allow_writes=true.

exec: // Every request: answered within the time budget, and any body is JSON.

item.name: Health
item.description: Liveness. The bare /health is Render's probe; /api/v1/health is the versioned one.

request.description: First request of a run, so it carries the cold-start budget: a free Render service sleeps.

originalRequest.description: First request of a run, so it carries the cold-start budget: a free Render service sleeps.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Signed-out and badly signed-in callers get 401, never data.

request.description: Not a JWT at all, so it fails before the signing keys are fetched: 401 with or without Auth0 configured.

item.name: Me
item.description: Who each token belongs to. Saves the ids the later folders need.
